adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Repeated high-dose albuterol can lower serum potassium by beta2-mediated stimulation of Na+/K+ ATPase. No GI or renal loss is needed because this is redistribution into cells.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Beta2 agonists can influence renin and other physiology at high doses, but the rapid fall in potassium without body potassium loss is directly explained by Na+/K+ ATPase-driven intracellular shift.
